title: valeriana auricula
intro: Valeriana auricula, commonly known as the golden valerian, is a plant species belonging to the Valerianaceae family. It is prized for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce stress, anxiety, and insomnia due to its sedative and calming effects. The bioactive constituents present in the plant, such as valepotriates and isovaltrate, contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include promoting relaxation, reducing restlessness, and alleviating symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of Valeriana auricula can be attributed to its sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a sought-after natural remedy for promoting overall well-being.
